newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-WILLIAMS IN LEGAL ACTION AGAINST NEWEY.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-WILLIAMS IN LEGAL ACTION AGAINST NEWEY.

text.p: World constructors' champions Williams have served a writ on their chief designer Adrian Newey in a dispute over the terms of his contract.
Williams, in a prepared statement, said Newey was "currently on leave" and the dispute was "an internal matter."
Newey, who expressed disappointment at the decision not to retain world champion Damon Hill, is reported to have received several attractive offers from other teams, including one from McLaren.
Newey, the most successful aerodynamicist in Formula One, forms a celebrated partnership with technical director Patrick Head and is well advanced in the design of the Williams 1997 car.
